description: This Swift source file defines UI components and caching mechanisms for a session menu preview feature in a macOS app, including data models, cache management, preview loading logic, and associated views.

classes.name: SessionPreviewItem
classes.description: Data model representing an individual preview message with an ID, role, and text.

classes.name: PreviewRole
classes.description: Enumeration representing the role of a message sender, with display labels.

classes.name: SessionPreviewCache
classes.description: Actor responsible for caching and retrieving session preview snapshots.

classes.name: SessionPreviewLimiter
classes.description: Actor managing concurrent access permits for preview requests, limiting simultaneous fetches.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewSnapshot
classes.description: Struct representing a snapshot of session preview items and their load status.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewView
classes.description: SwiftUI view displaying the session preview, including various load states and styling.

classes.name: SessionMenuPreviewLoader
classes.description: Utility class providing methods to prewarm, load, and fetch session preview snapshots asynchronously.

methods.name: cachedSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a cached session preview snapshot if it is within the valid age.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a snapshot in the cache with the current timestamp.

methods.name: lastSnapshot
methods.description: Returns the last stored snapshot, regardless of age.

methods.name: withPermit
methods.description: Executes an async operation while respecting the concurrent fetch limit.

methods.name: _testSet
methods.description: Test method to set cache entries directly in debug mode.

methods.name: _testReset
methods.description: Test method to reset the cache in debug mode.

methods.name: prewarm
methods.description: Preloads the cache with session previews for given session keys.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a session preview snapshot, either from cache or via network fetch.

methods.name: fetchSnapshot
methods.description: Fetches a session snapshot either via preview request or chat history if preview is unavailable.
